_comment: Non-secret registry of client Shopify stores. Tokens live in tokens.env (chmod 600), never here. Add a client by copying a block; the slug is what agents pass on the command line.

bazaa.label: Bazaa
notes: Admin URL for a product: https://admin.shopify.com/store/bazaahome/products/<numeric id>

Product metafields (namespace `custom`): category, sub_category_1, sub_category_2, height, width, depth (cm), state, suburb_and_postcode, google_merchant_shipping_rate (JSON, written by the daily shipping-sync job).
Vendor = the product `vendor` field; vendor detail lives in shop metafields namespace `garnet-vendors` (seller addresses at shipping.shippo.shipFromAddress).
Variant weight is variant.inventoryItem.measurement.weight — variant.weight does not exist in 2025-04.
Same token is used by the shipping-sync GitHub Action; it stays valid until the app is uninstalled.
